purpose: Root-on-demand managed-state debloat for Samsung Tizen TVs. This manifest is the machine-readable contract an agent should trust before touching a unit or an app.

keys.host: settings_file, tv_host, apply_groups, agent_enabled, masked_unit_count, kill_pattern_count
keys.tv: reachable (bool), api_http_code, status (power, root_ok, agent_alive, uptime_s, mem_avail_mb, running_apps, home_app), launcher_start_offset_s
keys.state.app_dirs: list of directory names under /opt/usr/apps - an id absent here is never-installed or already removed
keys.invariants.units: load-bearing unit -> {active, enabled}; enabled empty/unknown means that unit name does not exist on this firmware

apply_groups_map.home: which app owns the Home key (appsvc row + startup app id) - writes the TV's app framework DB
apply_groups_map.memory: package records for the heavy apps (app_disable/app_autorestart)
apply_groups_map.privacy: ACR/presence/telemetry flags and their app records
apply_groups_map.perf: the unit masks listed in /etc/tv-root-perf-units + the patterns in /etc/tv-root-kill-procs
apply_groups_map._note: Groups are internal to tv-root-apply. Nothing in this file can express a single-unit change; for one-variable work, edit the two state files and run the applier with --only perf, or mask one unit directly.

never_remove.symptom: App opens, every video fails with 'Something went wrong. Please try again later.'
Panel opens, every control reads 'Preparing... Please try again later'
DRM playback fails for every protected app

never_remove.breaks: root transport; also only starts ~121s into boot

never_remove.symptom: Home key shows nothing or a blank screen

invariants.live_changes_prove_nothing: A licence/panel acquired before the change keeps working, so a live test can report success for a unit that is actually required at boot.

verified_removable.note: Samsung Home app; not needed while sidebar+contentservicemanager present

verified_removable.id: reporterCA, emergency-log-transmitter, pvod-appfw.pvodservice, wireless-cam-service, wifi-presence, mirroring-recognition-manager, ambient-ua-agent, pisa-service, nagsam-daemon, ua-manager

verified_removable.note: ad + telemetry; data-service excluded, D-Bus activated

not_worth_it.reason: static + D-Bus activated (TriggeredBy org.tizen.tv.dataservice.busname) - respawns in seconds
launchpad restarts it within seconds; roughly 20 MB, not durable

privacy.summary: Fewer processes that can observe, fingerprint or report usage - verified by cold boot, not by packet inspection.

acr_removed.why: Visual Information Framework - Automatic Content Recognition fingerprints on-screen content

not_claimed: no firewall, VPN or DNS filtering is applied by this skill
no traffic was captured or analysed
store / account / app-update traffic still reaches Samsung endpoints
removing a component proves it is not running, not that the TV is silent

steps: move the app directory back into /opt/usr/apps
UPDATE package_app_info SET app_disable='false', app_autorestart='true' WHERE package='<pkg>'
remove the pattern from the kill-procs file

measurements.caveat: Only compare idle-to-idle; a streaming set holds ~300 MB more.

apply_contract.why: A single ~13 KB compound command executes only partially: outer groups run, middle groups are silently skipped, exit status still 0.

traps: no journal/dlog on this firmware - bisect, do not hunt logs
pkill -f / pgrep -f match the caller's own command line - bracket the pattern
UEP blocks unsigned scripts even as root - ship inline or as data for a signed interpreter
systemctl mask --runtime does not stop a running unit; some units ignore SIGTERM
launchpad-process-pool restarts apps regardless of app_disable - move the dir
REST /api/v2/ answering is not boot; measure launcher offset from /proc/<pid>/stat field 22

commands.apply: /usr/local/bin/tv-root-apply --dry-run  # needs an elevated shell; then drop --dry-run
commands.reboot: tv power off && sleep 20 && tv wake   # Wake-on-LAN; needs TV_MAC in /etc/default/tv-root. A mains-off cold boot needs a person.

verified_on.root_route: archive-launcher, one command per acquisition, no persistence on the TV
verified_on.note: Every measurement, unit name and app id in this file came from that one set. On a different model year treat each name as a hypothesis and confirm it with agent/audit.sh plus one cold boot, not as fact.
verified_on.model_note: size + series only; the regional/tuner suffix is omitted
